test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A container is normally filled in 5 hours. However, it takes 6 hours when there is a leak at the bottom. If the container is full, in what time would the leak empty it, if no water is allowed into the container during that period?
solution:
**Given**

Time taken to fill the container normally = 5hr

Time taken to fill when leakage is present = 6hr

**Calculation**

Extra time taken to fill due to leakage = 6 - 5= 1hr

Let the volume of the tank to be V

Part of tank filled in 1hr at normal condition = V/5

Part of tank filled in 1hr in leakage condition = V/6

Part of tank leaked in 1hr = V/5 - V/6 = V/30

So the tank leak 1/30 volume in 1hr

**∴ He full tank is leaked within 30hr.**
